topic: Grammar: spot the mistake in "She don't like coffee"

script.title: Is "She don't like coffee" correct?

lines.text: I keep saying "She don't like coffee." Is that okay?
Here's the fix: with he, she, or it, we say doesn't, not don't.
My brother doesn't drink coffee, but he loves tea.
Kit's tip: he, she, and it take does. I, you, we, and they take do.
Fix more mistakes free on lexkite.com

script.caption: Say "She doesn't like coffee", not "She don't like coffee"
